title: Text: DET Chad Crunk ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Is there a way you can see if this was Greene’s first time in LF?
This intra-squad. If not, it’s not a big deal, I can write around it, I just always remembered him being in right field but I missed a couple days
He played LF in yesterday’s scrimmage. Believe that was the only other time during the series of intrasquad games
Thanks, appreciate it. Also, you guys have done a really good job, I know there’s a lot of stuff going on. I think it’s gone real smoothly from this end.
Thanks, Anthony. Appreciate you saying that. Definitely been a team effort. Still learning as we go so any and all feedback is constructive
Sorry was on deadline but yeah, like I said, it’s been good. I give you guys a lot of shit but it’s noticeable
